unit: (issuer, fiscal quarter q) in the PIT Top120 with a content-confirmed first preliminary disclosure and an original (non-amended) formal report
signal: y_q = clip(ln(revenue_q / revenue_{q-4}), -1, 1) from the issuer's own first preliminary table; centred cross-sectional rank weight within quarter q, w_i = (rank_i - (n+1)/2) / sum |rank - (n+1)/2|
legA: enter at the close of the first XKRX session after the preliminary receipt date
legB: enter at the close of the first XKRX session after the formal original receipt date
exit: each leg holds H sessions after its own entry
excessReturn: total-return close ratio of the stock minus total-return close ratio of 069500.KS over the identical window
statistic: per quarter q: D_q = sum_i w_i * (excessA_i - excessB_i); mean over quarters with Newey-West lag 2 standard error
sampleRule: identical issuer set for both legs within a quarter; an issuer whose window is not fully matured or not fully priced on a total-return basis in EITHER leg is removed from BOTH legs; no last-price or zero fill
family: Holm alpha 0.05 over {H1_B2_vs_B1, H2_return_contrast_H126}; H252 is secondary and reported without family claim
costs: not charged: both legs trade the same names once each; the contrast is a timing difference, not a strategy NAV
dataRequirements: total-return (dividend-reinvested) daily closes for every unit's issuer over both windows, from a pinned snapshot with a content hash
total-return daily closes of 069500.KS from the same snapshot
terminal consideration for any issuer delisted inside a window, or that issuer is removed from both legs and counted
